intent: Project sidebar navigation: a fixed-width vertical column with a project header, section labels, and .sidebar-item links. Use .sidebar-group (<details name="sidebar">) for collapsible sections with zero-JS exclusive-accordion behavior.

structure.description: Project identity row: square avatar plus a min-width:0 wrapper holding .sidebar-title and .sidebar-subtitle (both truncate).
Navigation links; mark the current view with .active (selected background).
Uppercase section label — either a plain div, or the <summary> of a .sidebar-group.

aria.when: Recommended on the active item so assistive tech announces the current view (aria-current="page").

allowedIn: app shell, alongside the main content area, below the navbar

a11yNotes: Wrap link runs in <nav> or use <aside> + labelled nav for landmark navigation. In .sidebar-group the <summary> is the toggle and is keyboard-operable for free; keep .sidebar-section on the summary so the disclosure triangle renders. Pair .active with aria-current="page".

subcomponents.intent: Collapsible sidebar section built on native <details>/<summary>. Giving every group the same name attribute (name="sidebar") makes them an exclusive accordion with zero JS.

structure.description: Must be the first child; styled with a rotating disclosure triangle (rotates when [open]).
The section's links, as following siblings of the summary inside the details.

subcomponents.a11yNotes: Native details/summary supplies expand/collapse semantics and keyboard support. Use the same name="..." on sibling groups for exclusive-open behavior; omit name to allow multiple open sections. Add `open` to the group that contains the current page.
